PRAY.gloss: address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship
PRAY.definition: Address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship; say a prayer.

HARP.gloss: a chordophone that has a triangular frame consisting of a sounding board and a pillar…
HARP.definition: A chordophone that has a triangular frame consisting of a sounding board and a pillar and a curved neck; the strings stretched between the neck and the soundbox are plucked with the fingers.

RAP.definition: A reproach for some lapse or misdeed.
RAP.example: He took the blame for it.

HAY.definition: Grass mowed and cured for use as fodder.

PAY.gloss: give money, usually in exchange for goods or services
PAY.definition: Give money, usually in exchange for goods or services.
PAY.example: I paid four dollars for this sandwich.

RAY.definition: A column of light (as from a beacon).

PAR.gloss: the standard number of strokes set for each hole on a golf course, or for the entire…
PAR.definition: (golf) the standard number of strokes set for each hole on a golf course, or for the entire course.
